title: 第113章 主炉来信第112章 徐少阳影现
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
赤霞宗领队也道：
“我们应该先回临时驻地。”
“至少把炉图、证据和徐少阳的变化带回去。”
顾清寒看向周荒。
周荒没有立刻回答。
他看着冰湖上残留的骨灰。
屏幕浮现。
【第三炉口核心已破。】
【获得：炼骨残纹。】
【已标记：骨相锁身法残痕。】
【警告：北冥主炉已关注宿主。】
【当前建议：脱离三十六炉口核心区域。】
连系统都建议退。
周荒当然不会逞强。
他再能反吃，也不是不知道死活。
“退。”
周荒开口。
“带上所有证物和活口，回临时驻地。”
玄阳宗和赤霞宗众人明显松了一口气。
他们最怕周荒继续往里冲。

顾清寒点头。
“我来断后。”
沈青禾道：
“周荒走中间。”
周荒看了她一眼。
“我还没废。”
“左臂骨裂，道基刚承过骨寒，废火不能乱用。”
沈青禾面无表情。
“你现在就是队伍里最容易被点名的人。”
周荒无言以对。
这话无法反驳。
队伍开始撤离冰湖。
顾清寒封存炼骨残纹、骨针碎片、徐少阳炉灰、主炉掌印残气。
沈青禾则取走一小瓶湖底骨寒水，用作回去验炉性。
周荒走在队伍中央。
左臂被药布固定，右手按着剑柄。
他虽然答应退，但心神没有放松。
因为主炉既然已经看见他，就未必会放他安稳离开。
果然。
content_en:
The Chixia Sect leader also said:
"We should go back to the temporary base first."
"At least bring back the furnace diagram, evidence and Xu Shaoyang's changes."
Gu Qinghan looked at Zhou Huang.
Zhou Huang did not answer immediately.
He looked at the ashes remaining on the frozen lake.
The screen appears.
[The core of the third furnace mouth has been broken. 】
[Obtain: Bone Refining Residual Pattern. 】
[Marked: The remaining traces of the bone-locking body technique. 】
[Warning: Beiming's main furnace has paid attention to the host. 】
[Current suggestion: Get out of the core area of Thirty-Six Furnaces. 】
Even the system recommends quitting.
Of course Zhou Huang would not show off.
No matter how much he eats it, it's not like he doesn't know whether to live or die.
"Retreat."
Zhou Huang spoke.
"Take all evidence and survivors and return to the temporary base."
Everyone in Xuanyang Sect and Chixia Sect breathed a sigh of relief obviously.
They were most afraid of Zhou Huang continuing to rush in.
Gu Qinghan nodded.
"I'll cut off the queen."
Shen Qinghe said:
"Zhou Huang walks in the middle."
Zhou Huang glanced at her.
"I'm not dead yet."
"The left arm has a broken bone. The Daoji has just endured the bone cold. The waste fire cannot be used indiscriminately."
Shen Qinghe's face was expressionless.
"You are now the most easily named person in the team."
Zhou Huang was speechless.
This statement cannot be refuted.
The team began to evacuate the ice lake.
Gu Qinghan sealed the remaining traces of bone refining, bone needle fragments, Xu Shaoyang furnace ashes, and the remaining energy of the main furnace palm seal.
Shen Qinghe took away a small bottle of Lake Bottom Bone Cold Water and used it to test the properties of the furnace.
Zhou Huang walked in the center of the team.
The left arm was fixed with medicine cloth, and the right hand was pressing the hilt of the sword.
Although he agreed to retreat, his mind did not relax.
Because since the main furnace has seen him, he may not let him leave safely.
really.
